id: title:Piccirello:address post merge findings on leaked key revocation

review.posthog_relevance: Account security and OAuth session integrity, specifically preventing race conditions between access token deletion and refresh token revocation.
review.reason: The implementation P1.F7.H2 establishes an atomic transaction for OAuth token revocation and access token deletion. This prevents a race condition where an access token could be deleted while its associated refresh token remains active, which could allow account reuse or replay attacks. This is a substantive, bounded correctness improvement.
